name: Yiff Strip Trivia (EP3)
source:
Yiff Strip Trivia is an adult furry stripping game, where you answer increasingly complicated trivia questions, in an effort to strip a rather unprepared rat!

The third of a series of games by Furry Outpost. You'll be undressing a rat, but seeing as how everyone thought she was a mouse, the team prepared mouse-related questions. Whoops! If you get three questions wrong, it's game over! If you get through all six rounds, you'll be in the company of a rather annoyed rat..

[From [url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep1-trivia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Yiff Strip Trivia是一款成人毛茸茸的脱衣游戏，你需要回答越来越复杂的琐事问题，努力脱掉一只毫无准备的老鼠！

Furry Outpost系列游戏的第三款。你将给一只老鼠脱衣服，但鉴于每个人都认为她是一只老鼠，团队准备了与老鼠相关的问题。哎呀！如果你答错三个问题，游戏就结束了！如果你通过了所有六轮，你就会和一只相当恼火的老鼠在一起。

[来自[url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep1-trivia]itch.io[/url]]
